main_text.l: ARCHELAVS, loco Herodis patris Rex in Iudæa, Matthæi 2. 22.
ARCHIPPVS, verbi Minister, Col. 4,17. Philem. v.2.

ARCVS Dei in nube, signum fœderis inter Deum & homines constituitur, Gen. 9. 13. ad v.18. usque. Ezech. 1,28. Arcus Dei, i. potentia quam exerit in homines, Psal. 7,13. Thren. 2,4. & 3,12. Hab. 3,9. Apoc. 6,2. Arcus hominis, arma bellica & vis armorum, Gen. 48.22. Iosh. 24.12. 2. Reg. 6,22. Psalm. 44,7. & 46,10. Esai. 41,2. Ierem. 49,35. & 51.56. Ezech. 39,3. Ose. 1,5. Zach. 9,10. Arcus, robur & artes impiorum, Psal. 11,2. & 37,14,15. & 58,8. & 64,4. ] Arcu iactis sagittis Ionathas patris sui voluntatem Dauidi significat, 1. Sam. 20,20 &c. Arcu missis sagittis, Ioas ab Elisæo liberationem Israelis discit, 2. Reg. 13. v.16.17.
ARDOR: ardore percutiuntur præceptorum Dei transgressores, Deut. 28,22. V. Esa. 33.14. 2. Pet. 3.12. Iac. 1.11.
AREOPAGVS, vicus erat Athenis: unde Paulus Athenien-sem compellauit: Act. 17.19.22. Unde Dionysius Areopagita ad fidem conuersus est, v.34. Ac postea ibidem Episcopus factus, Teste Eusebio.
ARETAS rex, socer Herodis, cuius præfectus in Damasco paulum prehendere nitebatur: 2. Cor. 11.32.
AREVNA, aliàs Ornan, aream Dauidi vēdit, 2. Sam. 24. v.16,18. 20,22,23,24. 1. Paral. 21. v.24,25. ad construendum altare.

ARGENTVM: [purum, conflatum, percussum. Vide Siclus, talentum.] Argentum, aurum, æs & ferrum in expugnatione lo-richuntis Domino consecrantur, Ioh. 6. v.19,24. Argento abundant Ierosolymitani Salomonis tempore, 1. Reg. 10.2. 2. Paral. 9,27.

[Argenteus, numi species, Gen. 20,16. & 45,22. Iudic. 16,5. 17,2,4,10,2. Sam. 18,12. 2. Reg. 6,5.2. Paral. 1,17. Cantic. 8,1. Esai. 7,23. Ierem. 32 9. Ose. 3,2. Zach. 11,12,13. Matth. 26,15. & 27,v.3,4,6,9. Argenreus, nomen adiect. vasa, idolum, candelabra. Argentea, &c.]
ARGVERE: Arguendus frater, non odio prosequendus, Leuit. 19,17. (Vide Admonitio.)
